learnings.claim: On 2026-10-10 these official endpoints returned HTTP 200 without any key: Fed press_monetary.xml and speeches.xml RSS, TCMB kurlar/today.xml (XML with Bulten_No and ForexBuying/ForexSelling per currency; the Saturday fetch returned the 09.10.2026 bulletin 2026/191), the TCMB English press-release page, SEC pressreleases.rss, and CoinGecko /api/v3/ping. api.binance.com returned HTTP 451 from the fetch host, so Binance REST is region-blocked there.
learnings.decision: Use these as the primary finance feed set; treat TCMB today.xml date as the bulletin date (not fetch date) and skip duplicate weekend bulletins; send a descriptive User-Agent to SEC; do not depend on api.binance.com from runners (use data.binance.vision or CoinGecko). EVDS requires a personal key kept in secrets.
learnings.next_measurement: Add a daily feed-poll job that records newest item date per feed and alerts if any feed is stale >3 business days.
learnings.title: Keyless official finance feeds: Fed, TCMB, SEC, CoinGecko

learnings.claim: YouTube Help 'Get started creating YouTube Shorts' (fetched 2026-10-10) says Shorts can be up to 3 minutes, uploads max 1080p, titles max 100 characters; since 2025-03-31 Shorts views count every play or replay with no minimum watch time while the old metric is kept as Engaged views; YPP via Shorts needs 1,000 subscribers and 10 million qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days; the upload flow has a Get feedback button analysing hook and pacing.
learnings.decision: Track growth on Engaged views (not raw views) and on qualified Shorts views toward the 10M/90-day YPP gate; render at 1080p; keep titles <=100 chars; use the in-app Get feedback hook/pacing check before upload. Follow blog.youtube RSS and the YouTube Creators feed for feature changes.
learnings.next_measurement: Record 90-day qualified Shorts views and subscribers weekly and compute distance to the YPP Shorts threshold.
learnings.title: Shorts basics from YouTube Help: 3-minute limit, views vs engaged views, YPP Shorts threshold
